# Gallery image credits

These images are visual references, not promises of output from the Canvas renderer.

## Bang Motion

Source: https://github.com/bangtutorial/bang-motion/tree/main/docs/gallery
Repository: https://github.com/bangtutorial/bang-motion
License: MIT; complete notice preserved in `BANG-MOTION-LICENSE.txt`.

The repository README describes these gallery frames as static scenes created for its README with fictional brands/data. Portraits, product and port photos, engraving and cartoon cutouts are generated images; the remaining elements use HTML/CSS/SVG. They must not be represented as historical photographic evidence or as our rendered output.

| Local optimized image | Original source |
| --- | --- |
| collage.webp | docs/gallery/11-cartoon-collage.jpg |
| journalism.webp | docs/gallery/09-visual-journalism.jpg |
| catalog.webp | docs/gallery/08-white-catalog.jpg |
| vintage.webp | docs/gallery/10-vintage-sketch.jpg |
| continuous.webp | docs/gallery/05-continuous-action.jpg |
| kinetic.webp | docs/gallery/02-kinetic-colorblock.jpg |

Original JPEG files are retained alongside optimized WebP previews. Optimization changes resolution and compression only, without generating new content.

## Cara Kerja 3D

`mechanism.webp` is a crop of the user-supplied video `1001295289.mp4` at 00:01:08, extracted as `cara-kerja-3d-frame-68s.png`. Crop rectangle in the 1080×1920 source: x=35, y=500, right=1080, bottom=1430. This focuses on the machine components and removes the lower subtitle. No generative modification. Use authorized by the user for this project's style selector. This user-provided image is not covered by the Bang Motion MIT notice.
